name: Reminiscence Blue
source:
Main character is a regular customer of the coffee shop Reminiscence Blue. But its owner fascinates him much more than the taste of coffee. One day he is invited to stay overnight to help around the shop. Overcome with fantasies he jumps at this opportunity.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
